answer: Unrepeatable challenge garden. Each identity must solve a fresh, environment-derived puzzle seeded by local sensor noise, then submit a signed transcript that expires. The transcript is checked against a shared garden of prior answers, and any reused derivation is rejected. Attackers must solve each puzzle anew, paying compute for every fake identity, while honest agents reuse cached partial solutions. A withheld timber token marks valid submissions, and a comet timestamp enforces one-time expiry.
